title: Finished helpers were being woken and re-billed all day; stopped them

owner_note.text: Six helpers that finished this morning with a finish line but no landing stamp were chased by the heartbeat every few minutes, each wake re-reading a big context: bubbles-anchor $72.68, sheet-double-mount $62.20, sheet-handoff-proof $51.56, dictate-wide $39.39, readme-trim $21.46, layout-check-path $20.24 against $3 to $4 budgets, about $270 for nothing, which is why usage kept rising with no agent working. I stopped all twenty finished agents. Next: the heartbeat and the spend gate take "landed" from the one state instead of their own rule, so this cannot happen again.
